Collect old maps of the cities you've lived in. Framed on your wall, they tell your story better than any poster.
Learn to make one perfect cocktail-free drink. A fresh lemonade, a spiced tea. Being the friend with a signature drink is rare.
Listen to full jazz albums on vinyl on Sunday mornings. Slow, warm, and a completely different way to start the day.
Play chess in the park with strangers. You'll meet older players with incredible stories and learn something every game.
Know the story behind everything you own. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and it makes ordinary things fascinating.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. It makes ordinary things fascinating.

slides.texte_overlay: Keep a notebook of every good restaurant you've tried. Friends will start asking you where to eat. Start the notebook today.
Write letters instead of texts on birthdays. In a world of quick messages, a handwritten card feels incredibly personal.
